items.prompt: Why does multiply allocate fresh product rows before returning?

options.text: To preserve factors needed by later output entries.
options.why: Overwriting an input factor during the product can corrupt subsequent row-column sums.
Fresh storage prevents aliasing corruption; it does not change algebraic noncommutativity.

options.text: To ensure every matrix entry becomes distinct.
options.why: Output values may repeat; fresh containers do not force distinct numbers.

options.text: To avoid all multiplication and use row sums instead.
options.why: The product still requires the row-column multiply-add recurrence.

items.explanation: Overwriting an input factor during the product can corrupt subsequent row-column sums.
